convert_mot_to_coco: convert MOT dataset labels to COCO-VID format by specifying input and output paths
convert_mot_detections: convert MOT detection results to COCO format with the --convert-det flag
split_mot_train_set: split the MOT train set into half-train and half-validate subsets with --split-train
parse_mot_ground_truths: parse MOT ground truth annotations into frame-indexed dictionaries with category and bbox info
parse_mot_detections: parse MOT detection results into frame-indexed bounding box lists with confidence scores
